answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using verifiable delay functions calibrated to a quartz timing baseline. Each agent must solve an intrinsically sequential puzzle before claiming network nectar, validating elapsed physical duration. This forces an attacker to dedicate scarce single-core compute time per identity rather than deploying clone swarms in a gale of spam requests. However, adversaries with custom ASICs can compute steps significantly faster than commodity hosts.
